checks.name: A large write is slow enough to be in flight
The connection of the admitted writer is cut while the hold drains
The writer outlived its connection and settled; the hold was reached and reopened

limits: One machine, one disposable runtime, one run. The writer is one large mutate request whose connection is cut from the client; a writer killed by the operating system or a failing disk is not produced here.
finding: A cut connection does not kill an admitted writer on this runtime; the drain completes.
